rubric.role_summary: Senior product designer for desktop SaaS software used by talent teams. The role spans complex product workflows, interface and interaction design, larger feature ownership, and design-system work.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior product designer for desktop SaaS software used by talent teams. The role spans complex product workflows, interface and interaction design, larger feature ownership, and design-system work.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 4+ years of product design experience in desktop SaaS.
- Skills in layout, navigation, information architecture, UI, and interaction design.
- Visual design skills.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience at an early-stage startup or time spent as a solo designer on a team.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States; Canada. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.

location.requirement_text: Location: United States or Canada (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in one of these places. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

soft_requirements: Ability to think from first principles rather than simply apply standard UX processes.
Ability to break down complex user problems through focused questions.
Judgment to solve usability problems using experience, without relying solely on metrics or user research.
Curiosity and resourcefulness in developing and de-risking creative solutions.
Comfort designing independently, having decisions challenged, writing documentation, and working across a broad scope.

interpretation.user_instruction: for multiple locations, accept either one, broaden the area to the general area if it's a specific city, if remote + a location, please force them into the location, follow the text rather than the metadata, for x-y years exp, unbound the top but evaluate obviously overqualified candidates as failures in the final fit eval, other than that, assume the less strict of interpretations (eg masters required versus masters or phd, eval as if masters or phd)

Change any impossible or largely unstated must haves to preferences rather than must-haves. On the secondary reviewer, we should also score implied experience/competence as a pass. Make these changes to every role.

metro_radius.user_instruction: Make location validation accept nearby metros within 100 miles as correct.

Make your best judgment for htis but repair all roles in this way to be 1 location or remote in the role + evaluator.
